subject.title: Export installed agents as grouped Claw packages

question: Should this PR establish the experimental installed-agent export contract while the Claws RFC still classifies the implementation stack as prototype evidence?
rationale: The patch creates a new CLI and serialized package format whose portability boundary, ownership, and migration obligations depend on unresolved RFC acceptance.

options.title: Hold for RFC acceptance
options.body: Keep the implementation as a draft prototype, fix concrete defects, and defer landing until maintainers accept the grouped export contract.

options.title: Sponsor the experimental contract
options.body: Explicitly approve this export shape as the intended incubation contract and own any later migration required by the RFC.

options.title: Pause the export slice
options.body: Close or defer this PR if maintainers want the RFC and earlier lifecycle slices settled before export work continues.

recommendation.title: Hold for RFC acceptance
recommendation.body: Keep the implementation as a draft prototype, fix concrete defects, and defer landing until maintainers accept the grouped export contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The RFC history specifically identifies his product-model and schema-boundary feedback as a key acceptance input.
